#import packages

```{python setup, include=FALSE} 
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
```

# Import existing dataset
```{python, include=FALSE}
#Total  households
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\us_nhts"
file_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_merged_filtered.csv")

#Households with children

file_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "us_HHwithU10.csv")
```

#The number of total households and households with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Count unique HOUSEID in total households dataset
total_households = dt['HOUSEID'].nunique()
print(f"Total households (from dt): {total_households}")

# Count unique HOUSEID in households with children dataset
households_with_children = df['HOUSEID'].nunique()
print(f"Households with children (from df): {households_with_children}")
```
#The number of children in the households (0-5, 6-17, 0-17 )
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Create "Numchld" column: Number of children age 0-17 in the household
df["NumChld"] = df["HHSIZE"] - df["NUMADLT"]

# Create "Chldu6" column: Number of children under age 6 in the household
df["Chldu6"] = df["HHSIZE"] - df["YOUNGCHILD"]

# Create "Chldu6" column: Number of children age 6-17 in the household
df["Chld6to17"] = (df["HHSIZE"] - df["NUMADLT"]) - (df["HHSIZE"] -df["YOUNGCHILD"])

# Total households with at least one child (age 0–17)
numchld_count = df[df["NumChld"] > 0]["HOUSEID"].nunique()
print(f"Households with children 0–17: {numchld_count}")

# Total households with at least one child under age 6
chldu6_count = df[df["Chldu6"] > 0]["HOUSEID"].nunique()
print(f"Households with children under 6: {chldu6_count}")

# Total households with at least one child age 6–17
chld6to17_count = df[df["Chld6to17"] > 0]["HOUSEID"].nunique()
print(f"Households with children 6–17: {chld6to17_count}")

# Total households with at least one child age 0-10 ( and possibly over 84)
#chld0to10_count = df[df["HousehNumPersU10"] > 0]["HOUSEID"].nunique()
#print(f"Households with children 0–10: {chld0to10_count}")
```

#The age distribution of travelers (respondants) of households with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Group by age and count unique journeys
travelers_by_age = df.groupby("R_AGE_IMP")["HOUSEID"].nunique().reset_index()

# Rename columns
travelers_by_age.columns = ["R_AGE_IMP", "Number of Respondants"]

# Calculate percentage of journeys
total_journeys = travelers_by_age["Number of Respondants"].sum()
travelers_by_age["Percentage"] = (travelers_by_age["Number of Respondants"] / total_journeys * 100).round(2)

# Sort by age (optional)
travelers_by_age = travelers_by_age.sort_values("R_AGE_IMP").reset_index(drop=True)

# Display the resulting DataFrame
travelers_by_age
```

#The age distribution of travelers (respondants) of the journeys of households with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Group by age and count unique journeys
journeys_by_age = df.groupby("R_AGE_IMP")["TOURID"].nunique().reset_index()

# Rename columns
journeys_by_age.columns = ["R_AGE_IMP", "Number of Tours"]

total_journeys = journeys_by_age["Number of Tours"].sum()
journeys_by_age["Percentage"] = (journeys_by_age["Number of Tours"] / total_journeys * 100).round(2)
```

#The portion of adults respondants of the households with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Convert RespAgeSimple to numeric if it's not already (just in case)
df["R_AGE_IMP"] = pd.to_numeric(df["R_AGE_IMP"], errors="coerce")

# Filter for age groups and count unique JourneyId
journeys_18_plus = df[df["R_AGE_IMP"] >= 18]["HOUSEID"].nunique()
journeys_under_18 = df[df["R_AGE_IMP"] < 18]["HOUSEID"].nunique()

# Create a summary table
age_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Age Group": ["0–17", "18 and over"],
    "Number of Respondants": [journeys_under_18, journeys_18_plus]
})

# Calculate percentages
total = age_summary["Number of Respondants"].sum()
age_summary["Percentage"] = (age_summary["Number of Respondants"] / total * 100).round(2)

# Show the result
age_summary
```

###Filter out only adult respondants
```{python include=FALSE}
# Ensure RespAgeSimple is numeric
df["R_AGE_IMP"] = pd.to_numeric(df["R_AGE_IMP"], errors="coerce")

# Filter to include only rows with RespAgeSimple >= 18
df_adults = df[df["R_AGE_IMP"] >= 18].copy()

# Check the result
df_adults.head()
```


#Gender of the adult respondants who traveled with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Count unique HOUSEIDs by gender in df_adults
gender_counts = df_adults.groupby("RespSex")["HOUSEID"].nunique().reset_index()

# Map gender codes to labels
gender_counts["Gender"] = gender_counts["RespSex"].map({1: "Male", 2: "Female"})

# Rearrange columns
gender_counts = gender_counts[["Gender", "HOUSEID"]]
gender_counts.columns = ["Gender", "Number of Respondants"]

# Display the result
gender_counts
```
#Gender of the adult respondants of Journey who traveled with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Count unique HOUSEIDs by gender in df_adults
gender_counts = df_adults.groupby("RespSex")["JourneyId"].nunique().reset_index()

# Map gender codes to labels
gender_counts["Gender"] = gender_counts["RespSex"].map({1: "Male", 2: "Female"})

# Rearrange columns
gender_counts = gender_counts[["Gender", "JourneyId"]]
gender_counts.columns = ["Gender", "Number of Journeys"]

# Display the result
gender_counts
```
#Age group of the adult respondants who traveled with children
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Group by age and count unique journeys
Respondants_by_age = df_adults.groupby("R_AGE_IMP")["HOUSEID"].nunique().reset_index()

# Rename columns
Respondants_by_age.columns = ["Respondent Age", "Number of Respondents"]

# Sort by age (optional)
Respondants_by_age = Respondants_by_age.sort_values("Respondent Age").reset_index(drop=True)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Set seaborn style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=Respondants_by_age, x="Respondent Age", y="Number of Respondents", color="#4C72B0")

# Add labels and title
plt.title("Number of Respondent by Respondent Age (18+)", fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel("Respondent Age")
plt.ylabel("Number of Respondents")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)  
plt.tight_layout()

# Show plot
plt.show()
```

#Age group of the adult who traveled with children in Journeys
```{python echo=TRUE}
# Group by age and count unique journeys
journeys_by_age = df_adults.groupby("R_AGE_IMP")["TOURID"].nunique().reset_index()

# Rename columns
journeys_by_age.columns = ["Respondent Age", "Number of Journeys"]

# Sort by age (optional)
journeys_by_age = journeys_by_age.sort_values("Respondent Age").reset_index(drop=True)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Filter the dataframe to ages between 18 and 80
filtered_journeys = journeys_by_age[
    (journeys_by_age["Respondent Age"] >= 18) & (journeys_by_age["Respondent Age"] <= 75)
]

# Set seaborn style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.barplot(data=filtered_journeys, x="Respondent Age", y="Number of Journeys", color="#4C72B0")

# Define custom tick positions (e.g., 18, 20, 25, 30, 35, ...)
min_age = filtered_journeys["Respondent Age"].min()
max_age = filtered_journeys["Respondent Age"].max()
custom_ticks = [age for age in range(min_age, max_age + 1) if age == 18 or age == 20 or age % 5 == 0]

plt.xticks(
    ticks=[filtered_journeys[filtered_journeys["Respondent Age"] == age].index[0] 
           for age in custom_ticks if age in filtered_journeys["Respondent Age"].values],
    labels=custom_ticks,
    rotation=0
)

# Add labels and title
plt.title("Number of Journeys by Respondent Age (18–75)", fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel("Respondent Age", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Number of Journeys", fontsize=12)

# Ensure labels fit
plt.tight_layout(pad=2)

# Show plot
plt.show()
```

```{python echo=TRUE}
    plt.tight_layout()
```

```{python echo=TRUE}
# Filter data between 1 and 20 minutes
subset = df_reduced[(df_reduced["TourTimeMinutes"] >= 1) & (df_reduced["TourTimeMinutes"] <= 20)]

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
sns.histplot(subset["TourTimeMinutes"].dropna(), bins=20, binrange=(1, 21), discrete=True)

# Set x-axis to show whole minutes
plt.xticks(range(1, 21))
plt.title("Travel Time Distribution (1–20 mins)")
plt.xlabel("TourTimeMinutes")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
